page_summary:
The Earthshaker: Novel Outline is the canonical works-table record for PKD's primary text corpus item. The record links the archive's preserved manifestation of the work to the broader corpus and gives researchers a single place to follow its bibliographic and interpretive context.

The preserved archive item here is The Earthshaker: Novel Outline (Unknown).

The source record itself summarizes the work as follows: Wanderer Miracle Child Benji The Earthshaker (Coming) Ch 1 the wanderer returns to his village. The wonde miraculous child Ch 2 Benjie, the earth woman. The MC tells the story of the E. Never clear whether find e to stop or hasten the day (Being) Ch 7 Scenes the man. early life, by flashback from present Ch 8 The ideals of the man.

The entry is most useful when tracing publication context, later commentary, or relationships to other works.
